SD52-014.name: Archangel
SD52-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Barrage: Cost 5 or less]
This Nexus is unaffected by opposing Cost 5 or less effects.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by paying two costs, treat this Nexus as Cost 5 and return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your "MS" family Spirit attacks/blocks, put a core from the Void to any Spirit you control.

SD52-009.name: Aegis Gundam
SD52-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Ignoring the Cost of Braves, return an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

SD52-006.name: Aile Strike Gundam
SD52-006.effect:
Striker Pack
When your "Strike Gundam"-named Spirit attacks/blocks, this card in your Hand can change places with it in refreshed condition. [Exchange] can only be used once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

SD52-010.name: Buster Gundam
SD52-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or lower effects.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting this Spirit, return up to two opposing Spirits with one core on them to the Hand.

SD52-011.name: Athrun Zala
SD52-011.effect:
[Brave Condition: MS & Cost 4 or more]

This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
When your Life is three or less, once per turn, refresh a White Spirit you control.

[During Brave] Flash - (When Attacks)
By destroying this Spirit, destroy an opposing Spirit.

SD52-002.name: Duel Gundam
SD52-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

SD52-X01.name: Freedom Gundam
SD52-X01.effect:
Flash - [Advent: White & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
Negate the effects of all opposing Spirits, and return two opposing Spirits to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Cost 7 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

SD52-015.name: I'll Protect You
SD52-015.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. You can summon one Cost 5 or less "MS" family Spirit card among them, without paying the cost. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Refresh a "MS" family Spirit you control.

SD52-X01-A5223.name: Justice Gundam
SD52-X01-A5223.effect:
Flash - [Advent: White & Cost 5 or more] ((Your Turn))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Cost 7 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 7 or less effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return the opposing blocking Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

SD52-012.name: Kira Yamato
SD52-012.effect:
[Brave Condition: MS & Cost 4 or more]

This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
An opposing Spirit destroyed by this Spirit returns to the deckbottom.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the Hand. When this effect returns, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

SD52-008.name: Launcher Strike Gundam
SD52-008.effect:
Striker Pack
When your "Strike Gundam"-named Spirit attacks/blocks, this card in your Hand can change places with it in refreshed condition. [Exchange] can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by paying one cost, return two opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits to the Hand.

[LV2] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

SD52-001.name: Skygrasper
SD52-001.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you control any "Mothership" family Nexus, you can summon this card from your Hand. When you've done so, during this turn, you can ignore the "[Exchange] can only be used once per turn" clause of your Striker Pack and use it once and only once more.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
Put a core from the Void to an "MS" family Spirit or a "Mothership" family Nexus you control.

SD52-005.name: Strike Gundam
SD52-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Discard an opposing Burst.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

[LV2]
This Spirit's cost increases by +1.

SD52-004.name: Strike Gundam ［Deactive Mode］
SD52-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add every "Strike Gundam" to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the decktop.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
Add a White "MS" family Spirit card revealed from deck by this Spirit's effect to your Hand.

SD52-007.name: Sword Strike Gundam
SD52-007.effect:
Striker Pack
When your "Strike Gundam"-named Spirit attacks/blocks, this card in your Hand can change places with it in refreshed condition. [Exchange] can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by paying one cost, destroy an opposing Nexus. This effect can't be prevented by [Barrage].

[LV2][LV3] Cost 4 or less
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Cost 4 or less effects.

SD52-016.name: The Descending Sword
SD52-016.effect:
[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Then, if there is any "MS" family Spirit card in your Trash, during this turn, the attacks of opposing Cost 4 or more Spirits/Ultimates can't reduce your Life.
